problem: Can the Green-Ward record object be observed again inside the same finite completely positive pyramid category without adding a new measurement rule at each level?
bold_conjecture: Reflexive observation requires an external metalevel or an infinite regress of new observer constructors.
named_rivals: internal classical copying comonoid on the record basis
tests: re-observation agrees with copying the first record
only the designated orthogonal record basis is copied
claim_boundary: Finite algebraic reflexivity for the classical record subobject in the completely positive pyramid category. This does not copy arbitrary quantum states, derive physical apparatus dynamics, or prove that every pyramid contains a preferred classical record structure.
